text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BRRRING!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sound of the alarm clock signals the 
start of a new day.
choice_data_list:
Let's keep striving together with the 
Umamusume today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting my gear ready at once, I headed 
toward the training course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the mock races. The 
Umamusume slated to run are putting in 
laps on the track.
choice_data_list:
Everyone's working so hard for their 
dreams.

Everyone's working so hard for their 
dreams.

text_block_list.text: Totally, I feel ya~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
This place really is a treasure trove of 
talent! So many Umamusume just begging for 
my treatment~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪ I wonder which girl I should talk 
to first~?
choice_data_list:
Tazuna-saaan! There's a suspicious person 
over here!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, whoa!? Hold on, hold on!! I'm on the 
side of all Umamusume! Like, here's an 
acupotomy needle that'll send your stats 
through the roof――
choice_data_list: See, isn't that dangerous after all?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, it's not dangerous at all! Thanks to 
my training, the speed at which I roll 
hand towels has gotten way faster!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh... Then let me treat you instead~! 
Once you experience it firsthand, you'll 
see my treatments are totally safe and 
reliaaable, right??

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Until I get your approval, I'll hold off 
on the needle jabs~! Okay??
choice_data_list: Understood, I'd be happy to join you!

Th-Then let's just see how things go 
first...
I'll pass on that!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo~♪ In that case, hurry up and become 
someone who's super close to Umamusume☆
choice_data_list: ...A being... close to an Umamusume...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's wrong? You look like a pigeon 
that just took an acupuncture needle to 
the face.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Unless the recipient is physiologically 
close to an Umamusume, it won't prove 
anything, right?
choice_data_list:
That makes total sense, but... isn't it 
impossible?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all~! Once you put in 
some Umamusume-style training, you'll 
start looking the part! Probably♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Come along, Trainer... No, <username>!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to speed, fitness bikes are 
where it's at! Go, go, go!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Very good, faster! Let's pick up the 
cadence!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Backstroke is next! Let's keep swimming 
until our stamina runs out♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh! Your form is super stable 
too☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Lastly, let's build some core power with 
sit-ups~! One, two, re-lief! Three, four, 
re-lief!
choice_data_list:
(T-This is really starting to get 
tough...)

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Don't give up! You're not training alone—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Have faith in... our friendship!!
choice_data_list: F-Friendship...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand what she's 
getting at, but knowing I'm not alone 
makes a huge difference.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like the training we underwent 
alongside <chrname>—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa-whoaaa, huge success☆ Now that's 
what I call our friendship training♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work☆ Judging by the look of it, you 
got a solid workout in♪
choice_data_list: Um... Why are you in the infirmary?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, don't play dumb! We still have 
the main event left, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Let me give you a quick little jab after 
your workout~♪
choice_data_list: I-I'm not mentally prepared yet……!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine! It'll be over in a 
flash, so don't you worry!☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Stab stab and poke!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bullseye needle poke, massive success!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... The fatigue is completely 
gone, and I feel fantastic!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, judging by her look... Huh, it 
worked? Seriously?! What?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!! I really am a total geeeenius☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep this momentum going and rack up 
those successes~! You do your best aiming 
to be an Umamusume too, okay?â

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well!? Can't you feel that sharp, tingling 
sensation working its magic!?
choice_data_list: Bzzzt... My body is going numb...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way, did it work *too* well~?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Well, there's always next time! 
Don't let it get you down☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I don't think my body's gonna move for a 
while, so take care of things, 'kay? Bye~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having no other choice, I decided to 
rethink <chrname>'s training menu until my body 
could move again.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, I got it♪ Well then, right 
away, be something close to an Umamusume 
for me, please☆
choice_data_list: ...A being... close to an Umamusume...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's wrong? You look like a pigeon 
that just took an acupuncture needle to 
the face.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Unless the recipient is physiologically 
close to an Umamusume, it won't prove 
anything, right?
choice_data_list:
That makes total sense, but... isn't it 
impossible?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all~! Once you put in 
some Umamusume-style training, you'll 
start looking the part! Probably♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Just as you say, let's keep an eye on 
things as we approach the Umamusume♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Come along, Trainer... No, <username>!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Here we go~! First, a nice, easy sprint on 
the turf!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, you're packing quite some 
speed♪ Though you still can't match my 
getaway speed☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Next is breaststroke! As long as you've 
got stamina, there's no need to worry~♪

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...The way you swim reminds me of when I 
dropped a needle in the pond and 
frantically searched all over for it~.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the grand finale has gotta be 
Power♪ Running on dirt oughta build plenty 
of that! ...Probably!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Have a safeâaaagh! Did dirt get inside 
my heels?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work☆ You look like you worked up a 
good sweat♪
choice_data_list: Um... Why are you in the infirmary?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh come on, don't play dumb! We still have 
the main event left, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Let me give you a quick little jab after 
your workout~♪
choice_data_list: I-I'm not mentally prepared yet……!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it's fine! It'll be over in a 
flash, so don't you worry!☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Stab stab and poke!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
... I feel power welling up within me! 
However――
choice_data_list: Is that a tingling in your fingertips...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, not looking very confident, are we! 
Guess there's still plenty of room for 
improvement, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Aside from fine-tuning the sasabari 
needles―― maybe the training was just too 
light!
choice_data_list: It gave me quite a workout, though.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
No way! To close the gap with the 
Umamusume, I have to do much higher-level 
training!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
If this was Level 1――feels like we're 
gonna need at least Level 3, don'tcha 
think?
choice_data_list: I-I'll do the best I can...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ For my sake... or rather, for the 
future of bamboo acupuncture and 
Umamusume, you need to train more and get 
closer to an Umamusume's physique!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Do your best, <username>-san☆

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? I couldn't quite hear that! Would 
you mind saying it one more time?
choice_data_list:
I feel like that's a bit too heavy a 
responsibility for me!

I fear that's too heavy a responsibility 
for me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, she hurried away without 
waiting for a reply, but—

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there~! You're not getting 
away from me, my little test subject!!
choice_data_list: It chased after us?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Don't think you can escape from me, the 
one they call "Tenacious Sasami"~!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: TOTAL REEEELIEF!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hehehe♪ You can't get away now~!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Surrender yourself completely to this 
legendary acupuncturist, Sasami 
Anshinzawaâ

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Stab stab and poke!!
choice_data_list: Aaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! How's that? Feel the power surging 
through you, don't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh? Well, well, well!?
choice_data_list: My head is... spinning...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Ah... Well, I mean... right?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, byee-bye~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I should never take up suspicious 
offers... Engraving this deeply in mind as 
a lesson for future training, they moved 
on.
